notes.title: 0.8.1 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Our Dying World 0.8.1 Released.[/h1][p]This fixes a lot of small bugs from our big 0.8.0 and changes a few systems.
[/p][h3]General Changes[/h3][p]- Added Steam Cloud saves[/p][p]- Updated Max's shirt on his artwork to reflect its accurate white color.[/p][p]- Fixed several typos and capitalization.[/p][p]- Updated Rina's single-target healing skill. [/p][p]- Fixed Ryker's cover skill not requiring TP.[/p][p]- Fixed incorrect recipe for water stones.[/p][p]- Fixed level-up screen not showing your new skill if you've leveled up more than once.[/p][p]- Added version number to the title screen.[/p][p]- Fixed endgame choices looping the previous cutscene.
[/p][h3]Act 1: [/h3][p]- Updated spa art of the boys.[/p][p]- Updated the Golem Fight art.[/p][p]- Chapter 1 enemies will no longer crit.[/p][p]- Slightly increased Artificial Golem health.[/p][p]- Elite Hornets no longer use the "Wing Cleaning" skill.[/p][p]- Fixed barrel morphing issue.[/p][p]- Adjusted camera angle in the starting cutscene.[/p][p]- Fixed compass showing up too  early.
[/p][h3]Act 2:[/h3][p]- Act 2 is now sprinkled with lore books to find.[/p][p]- Updated the Max's Eyes art.[/p][p]- Nerfed the effectiveness of boost items.[/p][p]- Added a waypoint for The Emperor fight.[/p][p]- The Emperor can now remove negative status effects.[/p][p]- Fixed The Emperor battlebacks not correctly showing on certain skills.[/p][p]- Increased the difficulty of The Flower fight.[/p][p]- Fixed Circe showing up where she shouldn't be.[/p][p]- Removed the victory screen on the final fight.[/p][p]- Fixed chests duplicating in the final dungeon[/p][p]- Fixed "party members" showing up where they shouldn't be.[/p][p]- The final arena fight is now [b]correctly[/b], nearly impossible. Good luck : )

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474259/5838a987711c4c73e97ca24fc4ba5e900bb9a504.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 0.7.4 Released!
notes.content:
Our Dying World Patch Notes (v 0.7.4)

Updated the first golem fight. The golem now has a unique spite, battler, and new moves.

Updated the bat battlers and abilities.

Slimes now have been split in two! Slimes in the first dungeon will be a caster or attacker.

Fixed the bug preventing you from fighting the Lamp God a second time.

Fixed the failed-to-load animation issue for the Fox God boss.

Fixed mapping issues.

Fixed spelling and grammar issues.

This will be the final patch for the demo. We'll see you all again for the full release!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474259/d166ce946926e630fa54cf23582370b359f14308.png[/img]

notes.title: Our Dying World 0.7.0 Released!
notes.content:
[h1]0.7.0 Released. [/h1]

 [b]Reworked Comba[/b]t: 

- Guard now heals 2% of your MP and HP 

- Maxs Fire skills have been replaced with Inferno Infusion 

- Max has a new physical skill called Reckless Savagery 

- Max now has a level cap of 20 

- Enemies have new skills and have been rebalanced 

- Magic Stones have new animations 

- New State Icons

 - Max, Ryker, and Ashton now gain 3 levels after training. 

[b]Armor Rework[/b]:

- Weapons and Armor have now been color-coded based on rarity

- Certain armor sets have unique effects 

- Armor values and prices have been changed Armor artwork has been changed 

[b]Item Rework[/b]:

The amount of items and chests has been reduced and adjusted 

[b]Artwork update[/b]:

All the full bodies and headshots have been replaced with new art.  

The battle end screen has been updated.

[b]2 new side quests[/b]: 

- These quests are Kickstarter backer rewards 

[b]Reduced File Size[/b]:

- Over 400mb of unused files have been taken out 

[b]Map reworks[/b]: 

- Updated the Hidden Area, Wizard Shop, Angels Landing, Moaning Hollow, and Seaside road maps. -

- Cutscene changes updated the cutscene music, positioning, and lighting in certain scenes  

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]:

- Too many to mention.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474259/f5729fab6423132668e5b70ed649580575748fa2.png[/img]
